name: Kare to Kare no Hazama De ~Wedding March~
original_name: カレと彼の間で　～ウェディングマーチ～
source: A fandisc to the second Kare to Kare no Hazama De game. The heroine must choose who of the two boys she wants to marry and the consequences of her choice.
translation: A fandisc to the second Kare to Kare no Hazama De game. The heroine must choose who of the two boys she wants to marry and the consequences of her choice.
